html:
A Greek poet from Ascra, a village in Boeotia, who lived around 700 BCE, roughly in the time of Homer. Two of his poems survive whole.

  • The Theogony tells how the world and the gods came to be, from Chaos to the rule of Zeus. It is the main source for Greek myths of creation, and of Prometheus and Pandora.
  • Works and Days is addressed to his brother Perses, who had cheated him over their inheritance. It gives advice on farming, the seasons, sailing and honest work, and tells the myth of the five ages of man, from gold to iron.

Unlike Homer, Hesiod speaks about himself. He says the Muses made him a poet while he herded sheep, and that he won a tripod in a poetry contest at funeral games in Chalcis, held for a nobleman later said to have died in the Lelantine War. His picture of hard work and justice on a small farm is a rare view of ordinary life in early Greece.
sum: A Greek poet from Ascra, a village in Boeotia, who lived around 700 BCE, roughly in the time of Homer. Two of his poems survive whole.
